scope_note: This is one documented methodological episode within the Philippine trajectory, not the birth of indigenous psychology worldwide; the following passage explains Santiago's dissatisfaction with mostly Western literature separately.
statement: Pe-Pua begins her Philippine methods narrative with Carmen Santiago's 1975 fieldwork on pagkalalaki.
statement_zh: Pe-Pua 以 Carmen Santiago 於 1975 年研究 pagkalalaki 的田野工作開啟其菲律賓方法史敘事。
